archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave: October 15, 2026

entries.headline: Gran Turismo 7 Spec IV Part 1 adds Sportsland SUGO and six cars
entries.summary: Polyphony Digital released the first part of the Spec IV update, adding the Sportsland SUGO circuit, six cars, events, Scapes locations, and other features, while also previewing a 30th-anniversary DualSense controller.
entries.verification: Verified against the opened global PlayStation Blog post.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time converted from the PlayStation Blog timestamp.

entries.headline: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave Expansion Pass announced, first wave available now
entries.summary: Nintendo announced a three-wave Expansion Pass. The first wave adds four weapons, with the second planned for winter and the third for 2027.
entries.verification: Two opened Japanese media reports independently match on the announcement and rollout.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time converted from AUTOMATON's timestamp.

entries.headline: Hytacka announces 3D action game OVERSEEKER with a nine-minute trailer
entries.summary: The new trailer shows fast-paced 3D combat, parries, and magic. Platforms and a release date were not announced.
entries.verification: Two opened Japanese media reports confirm the announcement and trailer.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time converted from AUTOMATON's timestamp.

entries.headline: Kotaro Uchikoshi formally unveils new company Crash Keys
entries.summary: Uchikoshi will lead Crash Keys as it develops original projects; no specific game has been announced.
entries.verification: Opened AUTOMATON report clearly relays the company announcement.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time converted from AUTOMATON's timestamp.

entries.headline: Dark cosmic fantasy strategy RPG Myths from the Maw announced for PC
entries.summary: Half Human Games announced a turn-based strategy RPG for Steam and plans to launch a Kickstarter campaign in 2027. No release date was announced.
entries.verification: Opened Gematsu report clearly relays the developer announcement.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time converted from Gematsu's timestamp.

entries.headline: JDM: Ph4ntom Driver announced for PC
entries.summary: Gaming Factory announced a standalone arcade-racing spin-off inspired by Japanese street culture and folklore. It is planned for Steam with no release date.
entries.verification: Opened Gematsu report clearly relays the developer announcement and Steam details.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time converted from Gematsu's timestamp.

entries.headline: Epic Games Launcher: Epic Games releases a preview of its redesigned launcher
entries.summary: The preview features a refreshed interface and faster responsiveness, and Epic says AI tools were used in development.
entries.verification: Opened AUTOMATON report relays Epic's public release and attributes performance claims.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time converted from AUTOMATON's timestamp.

entries.headline: SQUARE ENIX GAME CONTEST 2026: Square Enix details its 2026 game contest with ¥1 billion in prizes
entries.summary: In an AUTOMATON interview, Yosuke Saito and Takashi Tokita outlined the contest, which opens December 15, 2026, closes March 15, 2027, and plans to announce results on June 30, 2027.
entries.verification: The opened original interview supports the contest dates and prize structure.
entries.timeNote: Beijing time converted from AUTOMATON's timestamp.

entries.headline: Gears of War: E-Day Incursion mod adds Halo and other character skins
entries.summary: Tom Whaley’s Incursion mod adds a skin selector to Gears of War: E-Day. Players can switch between Halo, Star Wars and Warhammer 40,000 character skins from the main or pause menu without repeatedly swapping mod files by hand.
entries.verification: The original packet contains the opened IGN report identifying Incursion and Tom Whaley. The report was reopened during this review; this item retains media-report status and does not include the sales estimates or other background events.
entries.timeNote: The packet timestamp, October 14 at 16:39:26 UTC, converts to October 15 at 00:39 Beijing time and is inside the fixed window.
